rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter exactly: reuses cookieFilterAction, same Validate/CaddyModule/Unmarshal shape, OUTER label idiom, registration and interface assertions placed beside cookie.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable lines pass through via Cookies() len check; quoting preserved; suffix kept verbatim via Cut on ';'; exact name match. Non-array (string) input silently ignored, and only the first ';' split is considered, which is fine for the leading pair.
rationale.scope: Only adds the filter, registration and assertions; no unrelated edits or refactors.
rationale.readability: Clear flow with brief comments on the dummy-Response trick and verbatim suffix; the nested action loop with break/continue OUTER is slightly dense but matches neighbouring code.
rationale.robustness: No panics: length-guarded quote check, Cut results checked, type assertion guarded; stateless Filter is concurrency-safe.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's (repo already does this for query/cookie), so extension means touching two places; otherwise self-contained and reuses shared hash/action types.
